stem: Not only I but also Johnny and Rose ____ fond of swimming and fishing.
reason: not only … but also连接主语时谓语就近一致，靠近谓语的是Johnny and Rose两人，用are。

stem: You are not going out ____ you have finished your homework.
reason: not … until表示直到完成作业才出去，until引出时间条件。

stem: I will lend you my dictionary ____ you keep it clean.
reason: 保持词典干净是借出的条件，用as long as表只要；even if表即使，in case表以防。
